title: The Purpose and Power of Fathers
paragraphs: I am glad you are here, glad you are watching this television program, and glad you are listening to this CD because I am going to share with you one of the most important messages you have ever heard and also to help you understand why God gave this precise thing. Honor your father. Let me start with some sad news. I'm telling you how important parents really are. You will find some statistics and reports that have been released over the past few years about parental research.

Time magazine has once again published a cover story about men and fathers this Father's Day season. This is what their research discovered. Number one, and I quote Time magazine, says: "More than almost any other factor, the presence of the biological father in the family determines a child's success and happiness." I want to repeat this. This is secular research. This is not from the Bible. This is what psychologists, psychiatrists, and behavioral scientists have studied, and this is their conclusion.

More than almost any other factor, the presence of the biological father in the family determines the child's success and happiness. Now, what immediately comes to mind is what happens if two women get married? If this research is correct, which they concluded from their studies is correct, then a child in a home with two mothers is indeed in danger. Here is another quote from the research. 38% of all children in the West now live without their biological father. This is an increase from 17. 5% in 1960.

In the Bahamas, the percentage is likely higher, closer to 40%. How important are parents? The research also said this: more than half of today's children will spend at least part of their childhood without a father. Dr. Blankenhorn's research book, " America Without Fathers," has this subtitle: Confronting Our Most Pressing Social Problem.

You might think it's drugs, AIDS, or gangs, but based on his studies, he said the most pressing social problem is this quote: "The absence of a father is the most destructive trend of our generation." Let me repeat that. The absence of a father is the most destructive trend of our generation. These are the results of scientific research. In other words, the absence of a father is more destructive than drug abuse, teenage pregnancy, gang wars, incest, corruption in government, and corruption in religion.

He said there is nothing worse for a society than a society that lacks parents. This is a point I found very interesting. Time magazine quoted their research again. I quote: "The absence of fathers is linked to most social nightmares, from boys carrying weapons to girls with children." They link this to the absence of the father. In other words, if you fix the parents' situation, you can solve the crime problem.

We continue to build prisons to lock up parents instead of investing in programs to produce better parents. Here's another extremely disappointing quote. The same research, Time magazine. Parental influences. 46% of all families with children headed by a single mother live below the poverty line, compared to 8% of those with both parents in the home. May I ask you to look at this for a few minutes? Just think about it for a moment. This is now a scientific research topic.

46% of all families with children headed by a single mother say they live below the poverty line, compared to 8% of those with two parents. This research links poverty not to a lack of money, but to the absence of a father. Could poverty, in reality, be a problem related to parenthood? The research makes that clear.

Finally, they say that social studies show that only 43% of the country's prison inmates grew up with their parents, and that the absence of a father is a better indicator of criminal activity than race or poverty. 43% of prison inmates grew up without both parents at home. Time magazine offered one last idea that I thought you might want to remember.

I quote: "Sociologists have linked the absence of a father to the likelihood that his child will drop out of school, be unemployed, addicted to drugs, be a suicide victim, be mentally ill, or be a target of sexual abuse such as incest." End of quote. Links between father absence, drug addiction, and unemployment. It is astonishing how little we understand God. Do you know what God does? God gives you a command but never explains the reason. God told us, for example, not to eat fish without scales.

That's all he says. Scientists have proven that every type of fish that does not have scales contains the highest concentration of cancer-causing mercury. God never explains that. He simply says don't eat any fish without scales. Now they have finally discovered that fish like catfish, umm. Tuna, mmm. Without scales, it collects mercury. Did you know that mercury is also a source of madness? The concentration of mercury in your brain can actually lead to a mental disorder. God says, "Do not eat that."

He's not saying that because you'll develop psychiatric dementia. That is why obedience in the Bible is better than arguing with God. Now, here God simply gives another order. God says: " Obey me." Watch this. Now, I want you to remember who God is talking to, why He is talking to them, and what His goal is. What does God do? God said to Abraham: “ Come out to me, separate yourself, and from you I will make a nation.” Let everyone say: "A nation".

Therefore, God's purpose in calling Abraham was not to establish a religion. God never gave Abraham a religion. God says: "O Abraham, go out." Genesis 12:1, “I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you. And through the nation that I will bring forth from you, all the nations of the earth will also be blessed through what I do with you.” In other words, I will create a human nation for all other nations to emulate. So God says to Abraham, I will give you offspring.

It will become a nation, and this nation will be the nation that all nations will be blessed by because they will use this model to measure all other nations. We know what happened. Abraham had a son. The son fathered another son, and that son fathered 12 sons, and they became known as the nation of the tribes of Israel. They disobeyed God, so He sent them to famine, and they went to Egypt and ended up as slaves and were no longer a nation. They were stripped of everything.

They had no name, no possessions, no lineage, no self-concept, and no intrinsic value. They were stripped. After 430 years, God spoke to a man named Moses and said, "Very well, I will try again. Go and bring them to me. Bring them out of Egypt for me and with the same instructions. Take them to a secluded place where it is just me and them, and I will make them a nation again." So God has 3 million people in the desert and he is about to create a nation. Once again, please listen carefully.

God is about to build a country, a nation, a people, and he has Moses as the first prime minister, so to speak, to build his people. What was the first thing God did in building the nation? Write this down. The first foundation upon which nations are built is law. Let everyone speak the law. That is why it is important to understand the importance of the law. The law creates the culture. Say it with me. The law creates the culture. Law creates society. The law creates the community.

What makes us a community is our shared laws. When we all agree on the same laws, we become a union, a common unit, a community. Therefore, the law produces a state. Therefore, God gives Moses, the first lawgiver, instructions for building a state. Please listen to me. What is God's plan for a state? So what you are about to read is not a religious instruction. It is for national development. The first commandment that God gave to Moses was these ten laws.

I will not read them all, but I think I will read the first one because it is very important. The first one is always the priority. God says, " Well, the first law of this state is that you shall have no other gods before me." In other words, a nation must have a standard by which to measure right and wrong, good and bad, acceptable and unacceptable. There must be a higher authority. Who is your God? This is why, when a nation has more than one god, it is no longer a nation. Civil conflict and chaos ensues.

But God includes another law in national development. Here is the law. He says: "Honor your father and your mother." Wait a moment. God builds a state and says if you are going to build a nation, you must honor your father and mother. This is a matter of national security. Oh, can you hear me? If you follow God’s laws, which are civil laws, cultural laws, penal laws, social laws, and health laws, you will have a great successful country. God said: O Moses, I am building a state.

Tell everyone that they must obey their father and mother. They should honor their fathers and mothers. This is a national interest. When you disobey your father, you are against national development. When you curse your mother, you are an antisocial being. Honor your father and mother. Why? So that your days may be long in the land that the Lord your God is giving you. Because look, I'm going to create a state. I will give you property. I will give you land to live on.

But you must make sure to obey and honor your father and mother. In Ephesians 6, Paul repeats this in this way. Paul says: "Honor your father and mother." He is quoting, of course, from the Law, the first commandment coupled with a promise, which says, “that it may go well with you and that you may enjoy long life on the earth.” Notice how God links longevity with honoring your father and mother. May I then suggest to you what is the opposite of that promise? Can anyone deduce that? What is the promise?

What will make your days longer? Honor your father and mother. So what will destroy you? Insulting your father and mother. Now let me tell you how God thinks. Well, there are some things that God puts before you as consequences. God says, " Okay, if you do this, then this will happen." "And if you do this, then this will happen." This does not always include death. But in this case, he said it would be better for you to be dead than to insult your father and mother.

In other words, society would be better off without you if you insulted your father and mother. You pose a threat to the nation if you insult your father and mother. He says, "I'd rather you be dead." Do you understand the point? Yes, sir. I hope I have shocked you this morning because we have not realized the importance of national security associated with honoring one's father and mother. Write this down. An important verse.

Ephesians 6:13 says, “ Children,” I wanted to put this out quickly because some of you are sitting here thinking, “If you had known my Father, you could never have honored Him.” Well, I have news for you. Listen carefully. The Bible distinguishes between " parent" and "father and mother". Please write this down. The father is not usually equal to the father and mother. They can be different.

For example, some of you were raised by your grandfather or grandmother, but your father is still your father, and your mother is still your mother. Your grandmother can never be your mother. Your grandfather or your mother's husband can never be your father. They may be like parents to you, but they are not your father. Let everyone say it with me. God is very intelligent. God never told us to love your father. He never said, "I love your mother." He simply said: Be generous.

Honoring someone does not mean loving them. Because some people, due to what they have done or have not done, make it difficult for you to love them. He never told you to love them. Rather, he said: "Honor your father. Honor your mother." He didn't even say to obey your father. Because your father might do things that you shouldn't do. This is correct. Is anyone still here? He did not say, "Obey your mother." Because your mother may be living a lifestyle that is not pleasing to God.

Or your father might ask you to do some things that are completely contrary to God's will. God has said that you must disobey Him. He never told you to obey your father. But look what he says in Ephesians 6. He says, “Children, obey whom? Your parents.” Now, the parent is different from the biological mother and father. In fact, nobody knows that better than the people of the Bahamas. They say that 78% of the babies born in our hospital are to unmarried mothers. This is a matter of national security.

This is destructive to our country, because where there is no stable father in the home, you have a criminal program that produces criminals. Say, "No, who is the parent?" The word "parent" means care. It is derived from the word "parental". To care, to give, to provide, to raise, to nourish, not just with food, but with emotional stability, guidance, and relationship. It means discipline. It means giving that thing everything it needs to survive. This is education.

Often, you might be surprised, but parents are not necessarily parents. Honor your father, but obey your parents. My son, I am your father. Go and get me a bottle of wine. Go to the store now. Bring me one. And here you are, at twenty years old. God's word says: "He who indulges in strong drink is not wise." Son, look, I just bought two kilograms of cocaine and the man on the corner is waiting for the money. Go and get it, and bring it to me. I am your father, my son. What do you do? Is this a father or just a dad?

Read the rest of the verse. Children, obey your parents. where? In the Lord. This is the crux of the matter. Come here, my son. Let's go to the club together. I will teach you how to drink. Boy, you can't handle your drink. He swallowed it. Why are you coughing from this cigarette? Be a man. Smoke it until you reach the grave. Is this a father or a parent? My son, you are twenty now. How many children do you have? It's time you had a little boy. You know all these girls, you have to get them pregnant.

He exploited them. Are you a father or a parent? There is a difference. You know, I've seen fathers who only show up at graduation parties. The mother raised the child for eighteen years, and on graduation day he comes wearing a tie and sits in the front rows, and gets angry because they do not appreciate him. You are not a father. what are you doing here? Are you looking for recognition for things you've never done? You are not a father. what are you doing here? This place is for real fathers. Calm prevailed.

Hey you. One of them said, "Well, you know, but he's the father. He has to come." no. Stay in the hallway until we're finished. And don't take any pictures with my son. You are not a father. You are just a parent. Where were you? The court has been looking for you for years to collect your alimony. And now you want to come and stand next to this daughter while she is in her graduation gown. Get away from here. You are not a father. You are simply a sperm donor. You are not on the path of the Lord.

Parents are the ones who guide you to the path of the Lord. Here is another verse I thought of presenting to you before you cry. Colossians 3:20 says, “Children,” pay attention to this repetition, “obey what? Your parents in everything. For whose pleasure is this? The Lord’s.” He did not say, “Obey your father in everything” or “Obey your mother in everything.” He says, "Obey your parents." The one who has been with you all day and night for twenty or thirty years, that is your father.

The one who was there to cry with you, clean you up, pay for you, go to school with you, help you with your homework, cry on your shoulder, and deal with your problems, that is your father. Any dog ​​can have a puppy, and most of them do. But it takes a real father to raise a child. However, God says, “ Honor your father.” I thought it would be helpful to clarify the meaning of honoring, because that would give you a little relief from your guilt. Look at verse 21.

It says: “ Fathers, do not exasperate your children.” "Look at verse 20." Children, obey your parents. " Look at verse 21." Parents, do not anger your children. "Look at verse 20." Children, obey your parents. Verse 21, “ Fathers, do not embarrass your children together.” The King James Version says, “ Do not provoke.” Parents deserve obedience. Parents may provoke. Provoking means being inconsistent, using double standards. You say one thing and do another. You tell me not to do what you do. You distract me.

That provokes the child. Son, I swear, but you don't. Okay? You're too young to swear now. You provoke a child. God says, “Honor.” Listen, here's why God says, “Honor,” right? Write this down. The most important component of the human family is parenthood. That's the most important component. Actually, the second point goes a little deeper. As parents are, so is the family, the community, and the nation. I think we've proven that from the scientific research we've read.

Whatever happens to parents, that's what happens to the country. You are exactly what your father made you, whether he was present or not. And more often than not, his absence is what made your situation worse. And by the way, let me say this quickly. Females need their fathers. More than men. God somehow established a strange relationship between a woman and her father that no man can understand. This is why the average woman makes bad decisions—because her father wasn't there to give her a sense of balance.

Most women are afraid of men. They don't trust men. They are suspicious of them because their fathers didn't instill in them the confidence to help them identify a good man. So they are afraid of men. Third, the father is destiny. These are the words Time magazine used throughout that entire article. In other words, whoever the father is, that is the destiny of the country. The highest honor bestowed upon a man is the title of father. God never calls a woman father. And why is it the most magnificent title?

Because God holds that same title himself. God bestows the highest honor upon man by giving the male the same title he has—the title of father. Therefore, we must understand what a father is. If a father is so important to God, He has given him to you as a human being. Let's see what that means. The word "father"—what does it mean? Write it down. It is derived from the Greek word " aba" or "pa," and in Hebrew, it is "Abba."

It means, please write these down: Source, Provider, Sustainer, Provider, Protector, Predecessor, Founder, Author, and Maker. A very important list. Father means source. Provider, sustainer, protector, ancestor, progeny. Genes mean genetic code. They come from the father. The source of your genes is your father. If you do n't know who your father is, you still carry him in your bloodstream. The basic genetic makeup of your life comes from your father. He is the ancestor. He is the source.

So, the father is the foundation. I love this phrase. The words founder, foundation, or source are what father means. Why is this important to us? Please write quickly. Why do you honor your father? Write this because, first of all, the father is the foundation. Second, the father is the root. Third, the father is the source. And fourth, the father is the genetic vessel. This is very important. The writing is very slow. What is a father? Say it together. Foundation. And what else? Root. And what else? Source.

And what else? Genetic vessel. Say it again. What is a father? Foundation. That's what he means. Root. Source. And genetic vessel. God says, "Honor that." Now, why should we honor that? I thought it would be helpful for you to understand what honoring means. Also. You know, the quality of a tree depends on the quality of its roots. Second, the value of a house depends on the quality of its foundation. Third, the quality of offspring is determined by their genetic source.

Fourth, the condition of the roots affects the life of the plant. You know, it does n't matter how beautiful a plant looks; if the roots rot, it's only a matter of time. Leaves don't determine the life of a plant. A chandelier doesn't determine the value of a house. Every contractor in this room will tell you that once a defect is found in the foundation, the government itself condemns the house. You could have expensive furniture and china in that place, but they'd say you can't live there anymore.

It's against building standards. Please write this down. The strength of the foundation affects the value of the house. God says: Look, you must protect the foundation, honor the foundation. You must respect the foundation. Why? Because it represents your life. Hating your father is like using a cleaver to cut your own feet off at the knees. Hating your mother is like cutting your own feet off so you have nothing left to walk on. It's your foundation.

You know, parents are so important that I thought we should look at parental influence. Parental effects. First, a rotten root destroys a tree. Do Am I right? Am I right? Am I right? No matter how big a tree is, once the root rots, it's over. No matter how much we advertise on CNN, life in the Bahamas is better. Come visit us. This is where God lives. If we don't fix fathers, beautiful beaches will be full of people stealing tourists' money.

If we don't fix fathers, when a tourist leaves their bag with money in the room and goes to the beach for a swim, there will be a Bahamian who didn't have a good father rummaging through that bag to steal the tourist's money. And don't tell me this doesn't happen. Yes. In other words, no matter how beautiful the trees look, and the ocean, the sky, and the sand, if we don't restore respect for fathers, the rot will be in the roots. There are beautiful women in the Bahamas.

You know you're sitting next to one of them right now. They're beautiful women, but they have stories about men that will blow your mind. They dress up. The women dress up a lot. They spend $200 on their hair, and $500 on their shoes. They travel to New York to buy a dress, and they walk around in heels I can never balance in. And when you see them, they look absolutely beautiful. But just ask them about the men they know. Look, the tree looks beautiful, but there's rot somewhere.

They carry this burden, this hidden pain. Men, listen. You need to go back to the foundation of the home. You're not just the "head" of the house. You're the foundation. You need to take responsibility for this family again. And that might mean repenting today and saying, "God, I'm sorry." You were a threat to national security. I wasn't just mistreating my family. I was destroying my country. Show me, O God, that in order to build a nation, I must first fix my own life. Forgive me. God will forgive you today.”

Appreciation. Second, a cracked or faulty foundation destroys a house. That’s why God said you must repair that foundation. Appreciate it. Respect it. Third, watering the roots gives life to a plant. Isn’t it amazing that you never water the leaves? Why do I say this? You know, governments in every country spend more on women than men. They invest in women. In our country, in particular, we have programs for women, programs for this and that, crisis centers, and so on. How come there isn’t a crisis center for men?

How come there isn’t a program to make men good at marriage and relationships? Why doesn’t the government adopt some programs that focus on men? The average man here, for example, didn’t learn anything about sex from his father. He learned it from a dirty book in a bathroom with a friend. And so he comes away with a distorted view of sex. And everything he saw on that disc or read in that book, he wants from his wife when he gets married. So the woman says to him, “ Where did you get that idea?”

"The root needs to be watered. I didn't come here to condemn men. Listen, men, I can't fix you until we understand the problem. So I'm not attacking you. I just want you to realize how important you are. You can't be careless any longer, because your whole lives could ruin the country. This is a matter of national development. We must be loyal to the nation. Water me, Lord. Come on, man. Say it. Water me, Lord. Say it again. Water me, Lord. Thank God for real men. They are committed to helping men.

Write down the number four, please. Fertilizing the root gives health to the plant. You don't fertilize the leaves. Once you fertilize the root, the effect goes to the plants. It goes to the leaves. It goes to the fruit. So when you fix the root, you'll see the plant flourish. Number four, respect the foundation. Because when you respect the foundation, you protect the house. That's why they spend so much money on foundations when they build a house, because the foundation is what determines the shape of the house.

More is spent on foundations than on the whole house, because you have to make sure the house can..." That foundation supports him. And the foundation must be designed to bear that weight. God says, " Honor the foundation." Now, let me lighten the load a bit for the men and offer the women some suggestions. When you protect the root, you are securing the plant. So the first thing a woman should do is start praying for her husband right now. And I'm talking about the next 20 years. Every day, pray for the root.

Pray for the foundation. Pray and pour oil on his baptism in Jesus' name. Do something. Pray for that root. Please don't. It doesn't make sense. But anyway, pray. Pray for the root of your life. The Bible says a good wife is a hedge around her husband. She builds a hedge around him. Because if he doesn't succeed, neither will you. Every divorced woman in this room knows what I'm talking about. It ruins your life. You give your life completely to someone, and they treacherously abuse it. That's truly painful.

What is the role of the father? First, the father ties the family to its source. This is so important. Write this down. You know, roots, no matter how big they get The tree is what anchors it in the soil. Isn't that amazing? No matter how large a tree grows, it ultimately returns to its root. No matter how far the branches spread, they all return to the root. No matter how long the vines grow, they always return to that small root. The root holds the whole family together.

So if you destroy the root, the vines may remain green for a few years, but they will eventually wither because the source connects the root to life. Second, the father anchors the family to the rock. You know, the root anchors the plant in the soil. And the foundation anchors the house to the rock. Without the foundation or the root, the house can fly away or the tree can break. That is why the foundation must be honored. Third, the father receives the nutrients for the health of the family. Men, listen carefully.

All the nutrients in a plant must come from the root, and the root must be connected to good soil. So a good father always receives new nutrients from God to feed his family. That is why a man who does not study the Word and does not spend time with God is a danger to the whole community. Your family, sir, is as spiritual as you are. You are the conduit of nutrients. You are the one who nourishes the family with advice and sound ideas. Advice, information, and insights.

You're the one who gives them confidence and security. You hold this whole entity together. And fatherhood is more than just a title. Look at point four. A father provides life to a plant. It's amazing that water flows through the root to reach every branch, because the water comes through the root. That's the father's role in supplying the entire family. And fifth, a father ensures the family will bear fruit. If you destroy the root, there will never be fruit.

Your children's talents, their unique potential, are tied to you as a father. You know, I was very impressed with my brother, Dr. Kendall Major, here today. He was, he was the first what? A periodontist. That's a big word. He's the first Bahamian periodontist in the history of the Bahamas. Give him a round of applause. Now, notice how old you were when you went to study? 16. How old are you now? 47. 47. How many years has that been? 20. 20. No. No. That's 31. Here's my calculator. Okay, look at me. Look at me.

Look at me. Stand for a minute. Stand for a minute. I want to remember this. Stand, Dad. Stand, Dad. Okay, that's his father. Thirty-one years ago, listen to me now. He wanted to go study, to study something no one had ever studied before in the Bahamas. His father believed in him, encouraged him to go. Do you know what he remembers? Thirty-one years. That kiss was like water, it was like food. He still remembers that he kissed me. He took that kiss back to school. It was like fertilizer for that man's soul.

That young man needed to know, "My father supports me." And not just hear, "Go, son. I love you." "Even before him." He, he felt cared for. That's a good father. You should be proud. You did a great job. You gave this country its first periodontist. You're a good father. Thank you for blessing our country. Do you see how great the influence of a father is? He gave the whole country its first periodontist. Thank God for having a good father. Thank you very much. You know, a few times I called Dr.

Major, and I hope I'll be allowed to say this because I just want to give him as an example. I would call him a few times, you know, to talk to him, and he would say, "Can I see you today?" He says, "No, I'm in Eh, I'm in Orlando." I am somewhere else. "So I say: "What are you doing there?" He says, " My son has a basketball game." I say, "What?" Then he hung up and cried because his son wasn't part of his current marriage. But he knows, he said once, "My son is at a sensitive age now.

He's a teenager and needs to see me with him constantly. He needs to feel that kiss my father gave me. In other words, I'm not just a father. I'm a nurturer. Clap for God. I have to make sure he gets that kiss. Can you kiss your child? My son is here today. Char, stop. Where's my son? Char. Oh, he works in the TV department. Hello, Char. He's the cameraman here at the TV station. My son, what a blessing to me. We hugged. We hugged two days ago at the airport. Just hug. I still kiss my son. He's 25. Why?

You never outgrow being a father. You know, the Bible says when you see Jesus, kiss the Son, and you will love the Father. He who hates me hates my Father. He who loves me loves my Father. Can you hug a child today and say, 'I'm the missing father'? There are children in the children's church who don't have a father today because Abandon them and their fruits will never appear. Look at the fruits that have come from this man. He is the firstborn son in my family, what fruits!

But the good father says, "My son, I do n't have much money, but I have a kiss." I am with you. It doesn't take money. It takes care, love, touch, and encouraging words. Please write this down. Number six. A father protects the family in times of crisis. Did you know that the strength of your home depends on its foundation? Or to put it this way: your tree can only withstand a hurricane because of its roots.

How many of you have seen those great trees that stood for a while, then were swept away by a hurricane, and realized that their roots were shallow? Some men are just shallow. They look big, strong, and cool, but they have no depth. And when a small problem occurs— losing a house or a job—they crumble. You are supposed to hold the family together. When you lose your job and the hotel closes, say, "Honey, we're still okay." You lose all your money, the business fails, say, "Oh, thank God, it's okay."

I'm going to stay with my family. I'm going to hold this entity together. Why? Because I am the roots. I handle the crises. That's what men are supposed to be. They're supposed to be strong enough to keep the family together under pressure. I'm amazed at some men who get married A woman was living a good life without them. Her life was good without them. Then they married her and ruined her life. And when she had three children, they started complaining. Woman, you've given me all these children.

You're trying to kill me. Let me say it slowly. Woman, you've given me all these children. You're trying to kill me. All this stress, all these problems. I have to buy food and diapers. Madam, I wish I'd never married you. Wait a minute. I'm confused. She went to her mother's house, where she slept in her own bed. Come on. With her own refrigerator and without children. She went and got her out of there and took her to your house. Now she's your problem. You can't handle the stress, the crisis. You're the root.

How was that song? You have to put a ring on it. Put a ring on it. How was it? Some of you saints know how it goes. Was it no, no, no, no, no, no. There's another one. What is it? Come on. Don't be so holy about it. You You know her. I know you know her. You don't know her. What is this? Yes. What? Go for it. I know you Ron Lowes people know this. Go for it. Come on.
